architectureDiagram.note: Re-derived and regenerated 2026-09-13 after an independent line-by-line audit against the real code (not on the strength of the prior audit's claim). The 2026-09-05 OTel span path remains accurate and unchanged. Four inaccuracies found and fixed: (1) a BUDGET node was drawn inside the deterministic core subgraph as if run/tool budget and steering enforcement were pure, model-free functions, when BudgetGuard/RetrySteering/EvidenceQualitySteering (apps/agent/src/runtime/interventions.ts) import @strands-agents/sdk directly and extend its InterventionHandler -- moved to the Strands runtime adapter's Interventions node, where the code actually lives; (2) the Sessions node named S3Storage as a session backend, but grep confirms zero production callers construct it anywhere in apps/agent/src -- only LocalFileStorage is wired, so S3Storage was removed from the label; (3) the Strands Graph/Swarm node omitted the bid-comparison pack (apps/agent/src/runtime/bid-comparison-swarm.ts), which is now the Agents for Humans hero -- added; (4) the Execution Targets subgraph drew SIFT_EXECUTION_TARGET as a live runtime switch between two paths, but grep confirms the config value is validated and logged once (server.ts) and never read to branch a request -- both HTTP surfaces are simply always mounted together -- relabeled to say so. No background loop, watcher, or scheduler (Standing Watch) is depicted; none exists in the runtime (docs/hackathon-enhancements.md's own audit: 'No background loop exists anywhere in the runtime').
